subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Keeping my body safe
source.subtopic: Protecting our bodies from illness: covering mouth and nose when sneezing or coughing

show.line: Atchoo! Cover your mouth and nose with your elbow. Stop the germs!

rounds.prompt: You need to sneeze. Which is right?
What do we use to wipe our nose?
We wash fruit before we eat. Tap it.
Someone is bleeding. Do we touch their blood?
Where does a used tissue go?

hints: Germs fly out when we sneeze and cough.
Blood can carry germs. Call a grown-up.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I need to cough.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I cough right on my friend!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cough into my elbow.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Cough into your elbow. Germs stay away!

parent_line: Knows to cover coughs and sneezes, wash fruit and never touch blood.
